# wechat-article-fetcher

> `wxfetch` is an MIT-licensed Python CLI and library that reads public WeChat Official Account articles (mp.weixin.qq.com) and outputs clean Markdown or JSON (title, account name, author, publish time in ISO 8601 +08:00, cover image, description, Markdown body, plain text, image list, and which extraction method won). Author: Yomin Ma (https://yomin.love, https://github.com/mrlong0129).

Key facts:

- Install: `pip install -e .` from a clone of https://github.com/mrlong0129/wechat-article-fetcher (Python 3.8+, depends on requests, beautifulsoup4, lxml).
- Zero-install for agents: `uvx --refresh --from git+https://github.com/mrlong0129/wechat-article-fetcher wxfetch '<url>'` (quote the URL; `--refresh` re-fetches on older uv). MCP server: `wxfetch-mcp` (tools `fetch_wechat_article`, `parse_wechat_html`). Restart the MCP client after an update. Agent skill: `skill/SKILL.md`; agent instructions: `AGENTS.md`. Sibling project for general web pages: https://github.com/mrlong0129/agent-web-fetch
- Usage: `wxfetch 'https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/<id>'`; `wxfetch 'https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=…&mid=…&idx=…&sn=…&chksm=…'`; `-f json`; `-i urls.txt --out-dir out/`; `--download-images`; `--from-html saved.html` for offline parsing. An unquoted `&` truncates the link.
- Fetching: requests are sent with WeChat in-app browser User-Agents (iPhone, then Android, then desktop Chrome) plus a WeChat Referer. WeChat's "环境异常 / 去验证" verification page (`wappoc_appmsgcaptcha`, `secitptpage`, `poc_token`) is detected. Switching UA only helps for client-based challenges. A long link missing `chksm` is reported immediately as `long_link_missing_chksm` (one request); a short link or a `chksm`-bearing link challenged on every profile is `all_profiles_challenged`. A pasted captcha-page URL is unwrapped to its `target_url`; `poc_token` is not sent back. The captcha is never solved, and no parameter is invented. Login-session parameters (`key`, `pass_ticket`, `uin`, `exportkey`) are stripped. Deleted, violation and invalid-link pages are reported with a reason code. Retries use exponential backoff, with about 2 s between articles. An article with images but no text includes a warning and the image count.
- Extraction: four candidates, and the richest wins.
  - `js_content`: the `#js_content` DOM, with lazy `data-src` images
  - `js_content_noencode`: the `content_noencode` JS string in `window.cgiDataNew`, used for text-only posts (`item_show_type` 10)
  - `picture_page`: the `picture_page_info_list` image list, used for image posts (`item_show_type` 8)
  - `og_meta`: the `og:title` / `og:description` meta tags; WeChat puts the full body of short text posts into `og:title`
- Markdown output keeps headings, lists, emphasis, links, images, code blocks and simple tables. It moves punctuation outside `**` so bold renders in CJK text, and writes line breaks inside a paragraph as two-space hard breaks.
- Images: mmbiz.qpic.cn serves the real image with no Referer or with `https://mp.weixin.qq.com/`. A foreign Referer gets a placeholder image.
- Limitations:
  - Public articles only: no login, paid, fans-only or deleted content.
  - A long `?__biz=` link that still has `chksm` can be read. The same link without `chksm` is challenged for every client; use the full original link or the short `/s/<id>` link. Do not invent a `chksm`.
  - WeChat may tighten detection at any time.
  - No JavaScript execution. A Playwright fallback is a possible future extra.
- Intended use: personal reading, note-taking and research. Respect copyright and WeChat's Terms of Service, and keep request rates low.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/mrlong0129/wechat-article-fetcher/blob/main/README.md): usage, JSON fields, and a "How it works" section (Chinese, with an English summary)
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/mrlong0129/wechat-article-fetcher/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release notes

## Source

- [src/wxfetch/fetcher.py](https://github.com/mrlong0129/wechat-article-fetcher/blob/main/src/wxfetch/fetcher.py): URL normalisation, UA fallback, retries
- [src/wxfetch/pagecheck.py](https://github.com/mrlong0129/wechat-article-fetcher/blob/main/src/wxfetch/pagecheck.py): verification, deleted and error page detection
- [src/wxfetch/extractor.py](https://github.com/mrlong0129/wechat-article-fetcher/blob/main/src/wxfetch/extractor.py): metadata and the four content candidates
- [src/wxfetch/render.py](https://github.com/mrlong0129/wechat-article-fetcher/blob/main/src/wxfetch/render.py): HTML to Markdown and plain text renderer
- [src/wxfetch/cli.py](https://github.com/mrlong0129/wechat-article-fetcher/blob/main/src/wxfetch/cli.py): the `wxfetch` command
